title: 第7章 黑云商会第8章 武技
content_zh:
苏辰走出家主府邸，拐过一个弯，来到了主路，便要径直离开苏家，而这时，一道略带讥讽的声音从一旁传来：
“呦呦呦！
这不是我们苏辰大天才吗？怎么不在屋里躲着，敢往外走了？”
苏辰眉毛一扬，循声望去，便看到一个与他同龄的少年一脸戏谑的走了过来。
这少年一身青色衣服，眼角狭长，说不出的阴冷感。
苏辰看了这少年一眼，似笑非笑的道：“怎么，苏海，皮子痒了？”
苏海脚步一顿，嘴角也狠狠的抽搐了一下。
他是三长老的孙子，从小与苏辰不太对付，但苏辰实力要比他高的多，因此，先前苏辰一直没少修理他。
“哼！”
旋即，苏海的脸色一沉，哼声道，“苏辰，你还以为自己是原先的那个天才？现在的你就是个一级武徒境界的废物罢了，你还以为你能打赢我？”
“能不能打赢，试试就知道了。”
苏辰微微一笑。
“艹！
都成废物了，还敢这么嚣张，今天不打到你跪下，我就不姓苏！”
被如此无视，苏海脸上也露出了怒色，一拳朝着苏辰轰去。
这一拳，携带着三级武徒的元力，威势不凡。
嘭！
一拳轰下，却没有打到苏辰的身体，而是被苏辰用一只手掌轻易接下。
“你！”
苏海脸色变了，他感觉苏辰的手掌像是铁箍一般将他的拳头狠狠锁住，让他动弹不得。

苏辰现在已经是三级武徒，又是修炼《太上武神诀》，此时实力之强，即使是四五级的武徒都能取胜，更何况苏海一个三级武徒。
“刚才你叫我给你跪下？”
苏辰玩味的看了苏海一眼。
“我，我……啊！”
苏辰手掌用力，苏海便感觉拳头似乎要被捏碎一般，惨叫一声，跪倒在地，疼的满脸冷汗。
“滚吧。”
随即，苏辰像是拍苍蝇一般，一掌把苏海拍到一旁，连滚了数圈，他自己则是大步向外走去。
苏海倒在地上，捂着拳头，脸颊抽搐，看着苏辰离开，忍不住骂道：“妈的，不是说他已经成废物了吗？怎么还这么厉害？”
……
苏辰走出苏家，用斗笠遮住身形，便向天水城中心位置走去。
他这一行的目的，乃是黑云商会。
黑云商会，是蓝月帝国第一交易场所，在每一城内都有设立。
凡是涉及丹药、功法、武技之类的交易，大多要进入黑云商会中进行。
苏辰很快来到黑云商会前。
黑云商会，是一层足有七层的阁楼，每一层阁楼的边角位置都挂着一个巨大的红色灯笼，上面龙飞凤舞的写着“黑云”
content_en:
Su Chen walked out of the head of the family's mansion, turned a corner, came to the main road, and was about to leave the Su family. At this time, a slightly sarcastic voice came from the side:
“Yo yo yo!
Isn’t this our great genius Su Chen? Why don't you hide in the house and dare to go out? "
Su Chen raised his eyebrows, looked around, and saw a young man of his own age walking over with a joking look on his face.
This young man was dressed in blue clothes, with narrow eyes and an indescribable coldness.
Su Chen glanced at the young man and said with a half-smile, "What, Su Hai, your skin is itchy?"
Su Hai paused, and the corners of his mouth twitched fiercely.
He is the grandson of the third elder. He has not dealt with Su Chen since he was a child, but Su Chen is much stronger than him, so Su Chen has always been trying to repair him before.
"Hmph!"
Immediately, Su Hai's face darkened, and he snorted, "Su Chen, do you still think you are the original genius? Now you are just a waste in the first-level martial arts realm. Do you still think you can beat me?"
"Whether you can win or not, you will know if you try."
Su Chen smiled slightly.
"grass!
You have become a waste, and you still dare to be so arrogant. If I don’t beat you to your knees today, my surname will not be Su! "
Being ignored like this, Su Hai showed anger on his face and punched Su Chen.
This punch carries the energy of a third-level warrior and is extremely powerful.
Bang!
The punch struck, but it did not hit Su Chen's body. Instead, Su Chen easily caught it with one hand.
"You!"
Su Hai's expression changed. He felt that Su Chen's palm was like an iron hoop, tightly locking his fist, making him unable to move.
Su Chen is now a third-level martial arts disciple, and he is practicing "The Art of the Supreme Martial God". At this time, his strength is so strong that even a fourth- and fifth-level martial arts disciple can win, let alone Su Hai, a third-level martial arts disciple.
"Did you just ask me to kneel down for you?"
Su Chen glanced at Su Hai playfully.
"I, I...ah!"
Su Chen pressed hard with his palm, and Su Hai felt as if his fist was about to be crushed. He screamed and fell to his knees, his face covered with cold sweat in pain.
"Go away."
Immediately, Su Chen slapped Su Hai aside as if swatting a fly. He rolled around several times while he strode out.
Su Hai fell to the ground, covering his fists with his cheeks twitching. Watching Su Chen leave, he couldn't help but curse: "Damn it, didn't you say he has become a waste? Why is he still so powerful?"
…
Su Chen walked out of Su's house, covered his figure with a bamboo hat, and walked towards the center of Tianshui City.
The purpose of his business is the Black Cloud Chamber of Commerce.
The Black Cloud Chamber of Commerce is the number one trading place in the Blue Moon Empire and is established in every city.
Most transactions involving elixirs, exercises, martial arts, etc. must be conducted in the Black Cloud Chamber of Commerce.
Su Chen quickly arrived in front of the Black Cloud Chamber of Commerce.
Heiyun Chamber of Commerce is an attic with seven floors. On the corner of each attic is a huge red lantern with "Heiyun" written on it with dragons and phoenixes flying on it.
